plugins.name: cc-enslaver
plugins.description: A Claude Code plugin and LLM-agnostic rule pack that enforces systematic thinking, verified citations, and root-cause analysis — eliminating reactive, lazy AI behavior. v0.24 is a health-audit release: architecture review + multi-path adversarial model review (every finding probe-verified; red-first regression tests, 310 → 323) fixed 10 confirmed defects, 3 HIGH, zero new features. HIGH: Windows state saves were silently lost to the plugin's own lock-free readers (os.replace vs an open reader → PermissionError → the mutation vanished; read accessors now share the session lock, save() retries against external readers, gc sweeps orphan tmp debris); the layer-(i) sync acknowledgement was lost in the one-shot grace window (the block → 同步核对-recovery flow never persisted the ack — the grace path now reads the reply and acks); a DENIED Write-new still registered its target as 'read'. MED: atomic rolling-patch counter; rule 10 no longer flags forward-reference annotations (password: "SecretStr"); rule 11 no longer flags URL routes (host-glued /home/ segments); requirements*.txt / constraints*.txt now scannable (.asciidoc joins the prose exemption); stale rolling counters cleared on recreate. read_guard's three write branches deduplicated into one shared content-check pipeline. Prior: v0.23 added rule 12 (repo-wide sync: sync-gate.toml co-update groups at Stop layer (i) + the repo-refresh audit skill), the 160-char TL;DR cap, and two HIGH production fixes (edit-gated layers never fired in production; state lost-update race); v0.22 added rules 10 + 11 write-time content detectors; v0.22.2 added the version-drift gate pinning this very file to plugin.json. English is the i18n skeleton and source of truth (rules/ + prompts/ at the root, default injection); Chinese is a first-class translation (rules/zh/ + prompts/zh/, CC_ENSLAVER_LANG=zh), with drift CI-blocked by i18n_check.py + test_i18n_sync.py.
